media.title: Casino de Paris, rue de Clichy — postcard, c. 1910
media.description: Colourised postcard view of the Casino de Paris façade at 16 rue de Clichy, published in Paris by F. Fleury around 1910.
media.altText: Colourised postcard showing the historic façade and entrance of the Casino de Paris on rue de Clichy around 1910.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. Wikimedia Commons identifies the object as a postcard published around 1910 by F. Fleury and marks it as public domain in the United States. No photographer is identified; as an anonymous work published more than seventy years ago, its European Union copyright term has also expired.
